rv.q: This Top Girls is the most dazzling and acute revival that the National Theatre has mounted since Dominic Cooke’s transcendent production of Follies.
It's 'Top Girls', given the production it always deserved.
Turner’s epic revival feels dismayingly topical, questioning what we value, how far we have come and how far we yet have to go.

cn.t: Churchill's 1982 feminist classic remains provocative, with its audacious opening dinner party widely praised, though critics split on whether this large-scale revival adds depth or dilutes the play's focus.
